title: Eagle

description.en: Evidence-led Herdr Space overview across machines
description.zh: 以真实证据汇总多台机器上的 Herdr Space 工作态势

subject: Golden faceted eagle holding a multicolored wind streamer

description.en: A golden eagle turns toward one connected wind streamer held at its hooked beak. Its natural shoulders continue through the bottom viewfinder edge; the complete face and streamer remain clear of rounded corners.
description.zh: 金色鹰转头看向鹰喙轻衔的一条彩色飘带，肩羽从画面底边自然延续，完整面部与飘带均避开圆角。

description.en: Broad irregular flat facets describe the crown, cheek, neck and folded-wing roots. Golden ochre and umber carry the bird; saturated multicolored accents stay in one external streamer.
description.zh: 宽阔、不规则的平面切面描绘冠羽、面颊、短颈和折翼根部。赭金与棕褐构成主体，多色点缀集中在一条外部飘带。

description.en: Sparse mountain-pine needles and alpine leaves are pressed into warm limestone paper. Authored habitat geometry, grain and shadows remain separate from the transparent animal.
description.zh: 稀疏的山松针叶与高山叶片压印在暖石灰岩纸色上。独立绘制的栖息地纹样、纸粒和阴影均与透明动物分离。

palette.source: artwork/logo-family/eagle/2026-09-19-01/presentation.json background.base; authored presentation, not a website token

sizeNote.en: 24/16px marks retain the golden head, hooked beak and colorful streamer. Fine feather facets soften. Use transparent foregrounds without a tile or extra mask.
sizeNote.zh: 24/16px 保留金色鹰头、钩状鹰喙和彩色飘带，精细羽毛切面会柔化。小标志使用透明前景，不加底板或额外遮罩。

source.description: Evidence-led Herdr Space overview across machines

goal.en: Read the current Herdr Spaces, pane layout, task evidence and history across reporting machines in a private dashboard. Missing or stale evidence stays explicit; lifecycle labels never certify completion.
goal.zh: 在私有看板中查看多台上报机器的 Herdr Space、窗格布局、任务证据与历史。缺失或过期证据明确呈现，生命周期标签不等于完成证明。

role.en: Responsive private dashboard with shared application chrome
role.zh: 采用统一应用组件的响应式私有看板

role.en: Authenticated report ingestion, full snapshots, history and public dependency health
role.zh: 受认证保护的上报、完整快照、历史与公开依赖健康检查

role.en: Local evidence collection, bounded spooling and idempotent delivery
role.zh: 本机证据采集、有界队列与幂等上报

description.en: Open mountain-pine needles and sparse alpine leaves evoke a golden eagle above mountain woodland. The habitat surface is independent of product features and other project motifs.
description.zh: 山松针叶与稀疏高山叶片，呼应金雕所在的山地林缘环境，形成独立的浅浮雕植物纹样。

alt.en: Golden faceted eagle holding a multicolored wind streamer on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: Eagle，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

description.en: An observant golden eagle for evidence-led work across machines.
description.zh: 以敏锐的金色鹰，呈现多机工作态势与真实交付证据。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Keep the existing portrait's natural frame entry. The full square is placed against the baseline; no anatomy is extended, trimmed or masked. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留原头像自然入框的边界，将完整方形画布贴齐基线；不补画、不截取解剖结构。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥55px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine material detail softens at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 55px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小材质细节会柔化。
